text:
Self-Evolved Reward Learning (SER) proposes an approach to reward model training in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) that addresses the limitations of relying solely on costly and potentially biased human-provided labels [2411.00418].

Instead of depending exclusively on human experts or advanced AI systems for labels, SER enables the reward model (RM) to generate its own additional training data, allowing it to iteratively improve itself. This method is designed to robustly enhance the performance of the reward model even when the amount of human-annotated data is limited, ultimately leading to improvements in the capabilities of large language models [2411.00418].
